visual_action: A montage of video clips showing Donald Trump speaking at a podium in what appears to be the White House. He seems to be struggling to read from a script or teleprompter. The clips are sourced from news broadcasts, with chyrons from Fox News and a logo from NBC News visible. At one point, the video cuts to a screen of TV color bars and static.

cast.name: Donald Trump
cast.evidence: Shown in multiple clips speaking at a podium, struggling to pronounce words.

cast.name: Fox News
cast.evidence: A chyron on screen reads 'FOX NEWS ALERT'.

cast.name: NBC News
cast.evidence: The NBC News logo is visible in the top right corner of one of the clips.

on_screen_text.text: TRUMP: WE'VE BEEN RIPPED OFF BY THE WHO

spoken_summary: Donald Trump is shown struggling to pronounce several words. He says "It's pergo-virus. Pergo-virus." In another clip, he seems to give up on a word, saying "well, let's see how we say that." In a third, he attempts to sound out a drug name: "IVF drug, go-null-f. So it's go-null-f."
audio_music: An upbeat, inspirational-sounding pop song ('Free To Be Me' by Francesca Battistelli) plays throughout the video, creating an ironic contrast with the visuals of Trump stumbling over his words. A bleep sound effect is used as a transition.
editing_pacing: The video is a montage with quick cuts between different clips of Trump speaking, interspersed with a cut to TV static.
central_claim: Donald Trump is portrayed as cognitively unfit or illiterate because he struggles to read and pronounce words correctly during public addresses.
intended_effect: To make the viewer mock Donald Trump and question his competency.
